format: WSDC Registry Events: other roles during a contest

source.edition: Version 2026.1C (page footers; the file name says 2026.1B)
source.quote_free_summary: Judges and scorekeepers may not take other roles (MC, DJ, contest team, photographer) during their contest; self-judged champion or invitational divisions are the stated exception.

requirement: Not detectable by the platform: covered by a signed attestation statement; the self-judging exception only through a documented resolution with evidence.
enforcement_point: Planned (design: docs/competition/governance/judging-integrity/OD-05-conflicts-design.md section 6A): database triggers on officials, designations and result versions. Not built.
interpretation_notes: Division type champion/invitational has no source-grounded attribute today; exception never inferred. Design only (PR-A): nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed. Applies only to WSDC-declared events; never imposed on NDCA, UCWDC or Studio/Custom.
applicable_event_versions: Version 2026.1C (page footers; the file name says 2026.1B)
decision_refs: OD-06 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A; retrospective audit PR #795)
